keyFindings.label: README claims 11 skills while 13 top-level SKILL.md roots are present
The registry has six hubs and seven standalone roots
Live retrieval is lexical and daemon-free, not memory-database/MCP backed
The validator registry contains 40 rules
The registered deep-loop mode is agent-improvement and no alignment mode exists
Cursor and Devin model rosters are curated hard allowlists
Advisor is a standalone daemon-backed system_skill_advisor MCP surface with nine tools
Advisor state containment is structurally hoisted above the outermost .opencode and graph state is package-local
The draft’s sk-create-diagram and /create:diagram surfaces do not exist; design owns /design:diagram
The live sk-doc registry has fourteen workflow modes, despite hub prose claiming fifteen
The draft’s /interface:* family is absent; current design commands use /design:*
The six live deep-loop modes use agent-improvement and benchmark names, not alignment
The draft's interface and create-diagram surfaces are absent; live design routes use /design:*
The live sk-prompt leaf is standalone with seven frameworks and internal operating modes, not a prompt-models two-mode hub
mcp-tooling live roster has nine modes while hub prose says eight
Runtime mirrors use different generated/symlink/direct-discovery mechanisms and current source counts must override stale manifest prose
Goal support is session-scoped but limited to OpenCode, Pi and Cursor; it is not universal across every runtime
Live hook kill-switch vocabulary is SYSTEM_* rather than the draft's MK_HOOKS_DISABLED
The live numbered worktree grammar uses three-digit worktrees/branches prefixes, not the draft's four-digit owner-first form
The draft's eight-mode ledger and deep-alignment claims conflict with the six registered deep-loop modes
The draft's universal goal coverage conflicts with the explicit OpenCode/Pi/Cursor-only runtime table
Old interface/create-diagram and flat Figma/deep-loop/prompt-model paths are absent while new nested paths are present
The parent phase map ends at row 29 while later 029-033 phase directories exist
Live worktree grammar is three-digit worktrees/branches, not the draft's four-digit owner-first grammar
Full draft reproduction confirms stale or false memory/interface/diagram, deep-alignment/eight-mode, universal-goal and prompt-model claims
Draft hook vocabulary, branch grammar, mode counts and numeric/runtime assertions need correction or reproduction
Durable claims that survive include specs symlink, Pi bridges, sk-code hub/review, executor consolidation, Open Design removal, Figma nesting and communication projection
